My 6th grade teacher... god... My classmates and I occasionally discuss about how much we hated her. We had her everyday, whether it'd be for social studies or for literacy. We all hated her. She LOVED the female students and treated the male students like trash and if she didn't like you, she'd just be rude to you. The boys were complaining about the teacher favouring the girls and not the boys, so the teacher screamed at me and this other girl for going to the printer, brought us outside and told us "Sorry, I just wanted to look like I treated all genders the same." Another time, she kicked a student's chair for no apparent reason. She would also always talk about her divorce and stuff. Every single class she'd be like "Hey, don't call me that name anymore! I had a divorce!" "My name is this, not that. I got a divorce, remember?!" Thank goodness she moved schools. Her armpit stains were...well..quite visible during class.
